slides.title: Round Robin CPU scheduling
slides.text: Round Robin scheduling allocates a fixed time quantum to each ready process. An unfinished process returns to the ready queue when its time slice expires.

slides.title: Relational database joins
slides.text: A relational join combines records from different tables by matching related columns or key values.

slides.title: JavaScript promises
slides.text: A promise represents the eventual completion or failure of asynchronous work. Fulfillment and rejection handlers respond to the result.
